title: SEKA ExAero GR Gravel Bike - Everything You Need to Know

takeaways.text: SEKA's 980 g claim for a size 54 is unpainted; the dealer expects about 1,100–1,200 g painted. The seatstay 'wind eye' is claimed to flex up to 16 mm.
It needs an outboard T47 bottom bracket (inboard versions do not fit), UDH, 12×100/12×142 axles, and zero-offset or setback seatposts; the thru-axle hex holes were tight and grabby on his frame.

SEKA rates 56 mm front and 52 mm rear, but the dealer knows riders who could not fit that: on 32 mm-internal rims a 50 mm tire can spread to about 52–53 mm and fail to fit the rear, so check rim width and tire together.
In September 2026 the frameset (frame, fork, seatpost) retailed at US$2,799, or US$3,299 with the Gladius bar, which he found stiffer than SEKA's road bar.

disclosure: Published by Power Meter City, a US SEKA dealer; the presenter has raced the frame for about a year.
summary: US dealer's buyer guide to the SEKA ExAero GR after a year of racing: tire-fit caveats, standards, cockpit and price.
